reason: H0 exclusively initializes and exercises wuffs_json__decoder and wuffs_aux::DecodeJson; it never constructs or drives the changed thumbhash decoder. Consequently it cannot cover QUIRK_JUST_RAW_THUMBHASH, the prefixed-versus-raw header semantics, or the quirk-dependent frame_config_io_position adjustment.
evidence: H0 enables WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__JSON and WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__AUX__JSON, and its fuzz paths call wuffs_json__decoder__decode_tokens or wuffs_aux::DecodeJson; no thumbhash module, decoder, or image-decoder entry point is present.
decoder.set_quirk! now recognizes QUIRK_JUST_RAW_THUMBHASH and changes quirk_just_raw_thumbhash, while decoder.get_quirk reports that state.
decoder.do_decode_image_config? conditionally skips reading and validating the three-byte '\xC3\xBE\xFE' header when quirk_just_raw_thumbhash is enabled.
decoder.do_decode_image_config? subtracts 3 from frame_config_io_position in raw mode, creating quirk-dependent parsing and position-accounting behavior that H0 does not exercise.
recommended_action: Add a thumbhash image-decoder fuzz target that varies QUIRK_JUST_RAW_THUMBHASH through decoder.set_quirk!, checks decoder.get_quirk, and drives decode_image_config? plus subsequent image-decoding calls with both magic-prefixed and raw inputs, including truncated inputs around the header and alpha byte and streamed short-read boundaries.
